item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will continue to affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea on Sunday and early next week. Showers will be heavier at times with squally thunderstorms over the region. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will still be showers over the region in the middle to latter parts of next week.
